notes.title: The Product Version is Available Now!
notes.notes:
Introduction of the Development Team
We are the Magic Stone Guardians development team. Today we have released the production version of the game!

We started development in 2020 and have been working on it for 3 years.
Our development team is very small, mainly 1 programmer and 1 3D artist.


Concept of this game
Magic Stone Guardians began its planning with the realization that "Grabbing and combining cubes in VR is a fun operation."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41000297/9becec4b470f888891d3c9be943e43498a614d75.png

We then incorporated that experience into a tower defense format, and the prototype was created.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41000297/f637408aa85a6670fc9008c21d63afad52ad7dc0.png

As a result, we were able to create a game with originality, combined with the fact that tower defense games in VR are rare and the experience of commanding an army is fun.

We hope that users will enjoy an experience that can only be had with Magic Stone Guardians!


Exhibiting at Events
We have been exhibiting at various events to receive feedback from our users and make improvements.

In September 2022, we exhibited at the Tokyo Game Show and had many general users try out the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41000297/a01e5059dbcc5de71d26b56bdc84c0239ce2b5e9.jpg

In March 2023, we exhibited at GDC2023 (Game Developers Conference) in San Francisco and received advice from game developers from around the world.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41000297/d955c3f5762f7518e18673b8a2c56a06ce2c878e.jpg

And we will exhibit again at the Tokyo Game Show in September 2023!
We are looking forward to seeing many people enjoy Magic Stone Guardians.

About future updates
We plan to fix bugs and add content based on user response.
We are also looking to add more Guardians and enemies and more waves.
Please feel free to let us know your requests in reviews, in the Steam community or on Twitter!


Twitter account

We will keep you updated on the latest news and introduce the game to you.
